description: This source file defines an extension class for the ISiloBuilder interface in Orleans to configure an in-memory lease provider for development purposes. It contains methods to add the InMemoryLeaseProvider as a service, specifically for testing or development scenarios.

classes.name: DevelopmentSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure development-related features such as in-memory lease providers.

methods.name: UseInMemoryLeaseProvider
methods.description: Extension method that configures the silo builder to use the in-memory lease provider for development and testing scenarios.
